Logistics private Limited (‘Corporate Debtor’) under Section 30 of the 
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (‘the Code ’) with following 
prayers:  
(a) Approve the Resolution Plan submitted by Mr. Suyog Sati sh 
Pachange being annexed as Exhibit “P” to this Application.

Resolution Applicant and any other person involved in the 
Resolution Plan to implement the Resolution Plan upon 
approval;

10. It is submitted that on 04.10.2023, the Applicant received a letter  (“Exhibit 
– M”) from Mr. Suyog Satish Pachange stating that in the event any financial 
creditor dissented or abstained from voting on the Resolution Plan, he was 
agreeable to pay such financial creditor the amount payable to them in 
accordance with the provisions of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 
2016 and the regulations framed th ereunder, subject to the total amount 
payable and the annual outgoes under the Resolution Plan dated 15.05.2023 
are not modified. 
 
11. The Applicant stated that in the 6th meeting of the CoC, held on 12.10.2023, 
the Resolution Plan submitted by Mr. Suyog Satish Pachange was placed for 
voting. The voting window remained open from 16.10.2023 to 23.10.2023. 
Pursuant to the said voting, the CoC, with 66.12% vot es approved the said 
Resolution Plan, while Intec Capital Limited holding 33.88% voting share 
has not voted. Agenda 1 pertains to voting on the resolution plan submitted 
by Mr. Suyog Satish Pachange and Agenda 2 pertains to approving the 
expense incurred by RP for obtaining 29A Analysis Report.

I.A. (Plan) 01 of 2024 in CP (IB) NO. 1258 OF 2020 
Page 34 of 36 
ORDER 
 
A. The Corporate Debtor, Atharva Auto Logistics Private Limited , 
CIN U63030PN201 4PTC152640, is hereby directed to be 
liquidated in accordance with the provisions of Chapter III of the 
Code and applicable regulations. Consequently, the Applicant/RP 
stands relieved subject to procedural/necessary compliances under 
Section 34(5) of the Code. 
 
B. We deem it appropriate to appoint an Insolvency Professional from 
the panel of Insolvency professionals shared by the IBBI, as the 
Liquidator of the Corporate Debtor . Accordingly, Mr. Vinit 
Gangwal bearing Registration No. IBBI/IPA-002/IP-
N00091/2017-2018/10235 having address at Office No.503, Varun 
capital, CTS No.364+365/13, Off. J.M.Road, Bharat Petroleum 
Lane, Next to Citiotel, Shivajinagar, Pune, Maharashtra, 
411005, email id: ip.vinitgangwal@sudharman.in; having AFA 
valid upto 30-06-2027 to act as the Liquidator in terms of Section 
34(1) of the Code. 
 
C. The Liquidator shall initiate the liquidation process as envisaged 
under Chapter III of the Code and the Liquidation Process 
Regulations applicable on the date of passing of this order. He/she 
shall take control of all the assets of the Corporate Debtor and also 
continue or institute proceedings in respect of any avoidance 
transactions or fraudulent or wrongful trading, if any, as per Section 
35(1) of the Code. 
 
D. The Liquidator for the conduct of the liquidation proceedings will 
be entitled to the fees as per Regulation 4 of the Insolvency and
